title: Notes Shanghai Autumn/Winter 2026 draws over 21,000 visitors
summary: The sixth edition of Notes Shanghai, held from October 14 to 17, 2026, at the Shanghai West Bund International Convention and Exhibition Center alongside Beauty Shanghai, brought together 224 fragrance brands and 10 fragrance houses. Over 65 brands participated in the fair for the first time, including Bortnikoff (Thailand), Escentric Molecules (UK), Gritti (Italy), J.F.
